title: Servora Intelligence
description: Revenue, food cost and stock signals calculated from your recorded operations.
dataSource: Calculated from recorded ledger entries, recipes and inventory, with no AI model involved. {{entries}} ledger entries · {{orders}} orders in the period.

states.loadFailedBody: Check your connection and try again.

kpi.noPrior: No revenue in the previous {{days}} days

agent.title: Executive query agent
agent.subtitle: Deterministic answers from recorded data. No AI model is used.
agent.placeholder: e.g. What is my food cost right now?

suggestions.cmv: What is my current food cost?
suggestions.sales: How much revenue did we record?
suggestions.inventory: Which items are at risk of running out?
suggestions.margin: How are gross margin and expenses?
suggestions.suppliers: How many purchase orders are open?

headlines.noRevenue: No revenue was recorded in the last {{days}} days.
headlines.cmv: Food cost is {{rate}} of gross revenue in the last {{days}} days.
headlines.finance: Gross margin is {{rate}} on {{revenue}} of recorded revenue.
headlines.inventory_one: {{count}} item is at or below its minimum stock.
headlines.inventory_other: {{count}} items are at or below their minimum stock.
headlines.waste: Waste is not recorded yet. {{count}} items are at or below minimum stock.
headlines.suppliers: {{open}} of {{total}} recorded purchase orders are still open.
headlines.stores: Recorded revenue by store in the last {{days}} days.
headlines.noStores: No stores are available in your current scope.

methods.cmv: Food cost = recorded recipe cost (COGS ledger entries, net of reversals) ÷ recorded revenue.
methods.finance: Gross margin = (revenue − recipe cost) ÷ revenue. Net result also subtracts active recorded expenses.
methods.inventory: An item is low when its recorded quantity is at or below its minimum quantity.
methods.suppliers: A purchase order is open while it is not received or cancelled.
methods.stores: Revenue per store from recorded ledger entries, net of reversals.

limits.ledger: Only orders that reached the ledger are counted; external sales channels are not connected.
limits.waste: Waste and spoilage are not tracked as separate records yet.
limits.inventory: Depends on minimum quantities being set for each item.
limits.suppliers: Delivery punctuality needs receiving to be recorded in Servora.

insights.title: Operational diagnostics
insights.subtitle: Rules applied to recorded figures for the selected period.
insights.emptyBody: Diagnostics appear once orders, recipes or inventory are recorded.

noRevenue.title: No revenue recorded in the last {{days}} days
noRevenue.body: Close orders in the POS so revenue and food cost can be analysed.
noRevenue.action: Record sales in the POS to unlock food cost and margin analysis.

cmvHigh.title: Food cost above the reference range
cmvHigh.body: Food cost is {{rate}} of revenue, above the {{min}}–{{max}} reference.
cmvHigh.action: Review prices of high-volume items and the recipe cost of their ingredients.

cmvOk.title: Food cost within the reference range
cmvOk.body: Food cost is {{rate}} of revenue, within or below the {{min}}–{{max}} reference.
cmvOk.action: Keep recipe costs updated when supplier prices change.

lowStock.title_one: {{count}} item at or below minimum stock
lowStock.title_other: {{count}} items at or below minimum stock
lowStock.body: Items may run out before the next delivery.
lowStock.action: Create a purchase order for the affected items.

noRecipes.title: No recipes registered
noRecipes.body: Without recipes, sales do not generate recipe cost and food cost stays at zero.
noRecipes.action: Register recipes for your best-selling items.
